s.note: Sheet-pan pizza cut in squares. Seventeen empty desks in third grade.
s.how: Oil a large baking tray and press the dough out to the edges, then rest it for 10 minutes. Spread with the sauce, scatter over the cheese, pepperoni and oregano. Bake at 230C on the lowest shelf until the base is crisp and the cheese bubbles. Cut into neat squares and serve.

s.n: Wellness check crispy potato bites with ranch
s.note: Crisp crispy potato bites and buttermilk ranch.
s.how: Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise, herbs, garlic and a squeeze of lemon into a ranch dressing. Spread the gems on lined trays and bake at 220C, shaking once, until deep golden. Salt well and serve with the ranch.

m.note: Saucy beef mince on soft buns. Aunt Gladys drops in on the principal.
m.how: Brown the mince in the oil, breaking it up. Add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft. Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, mustard and Worcestershire and simmer until thick and glossy. Toast the buns, add a slice of cheese and pile on the filling.

m.note: Chicken and vegetables under flaky pastry.
m.how: Brown the chicken in half the butter and lift it out. Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, then the stock and cream. Return the chicken with the peas and thyme, simmer until thick, then tip into a pie dish. Lay over the pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden. Rest for 5 minutes and serve.

w.note: Dark chocolate custard and whipped cream.
w.how: Whisk the sugar, cornflour, cocoa and yolks with a little of the milk until smooth. Heat the rest of the milk, whisk it in and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbling. Take off the heat, stir in the chocolate and vanilla and pour into 4 cups. Chill until set, then top with cream and crushed wafers.

d.note: Water won't help me, says Gladys. Ice-cold and drunk through a straw.
d.how: Chill the cartons until icy. Hand them out with a straw each.
